summary: SAB Biotherapeutics filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 that the U.S. FDA granted Fast Track designation to SAB-142, a fully human anti-thymocyte immunoglobulin being developed as a potentially disease-modifying immunotherapy for individuals with new-onset Stage 3 type 1 diabetes. No financial terms, securities transactions, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics were disclosed; the filing is a routine regulatory-milestone current report furnished with a press release as Exhibit 99.1. No deal terms apply; risk-arb relevance is nil, though the designation may affect clinical timelines and sentiment.
